title.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密

texts.zh: 庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
texts.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

texts.zh:
深入研究阿达卡利亚公约的研究我们发现，他们的科学家似乎不受任何公认标准的约束；不仅研究方法粗制滥造，结论也都相当平庸。他们完全不做任何仔细或勤奋的研究，几乎只专注于最堕落的形式。而且，他们的测试对象遭受的残酷程度越高，崇高指挥部的表扬就越高。

然而，他们早期的研究却讲述了一个截然不同的故事：实验对象在唤醒“内心风暴”的过程中是受到了善待和尊重的。事实上，比较起早期和晚期研究的成功率，不可避免地会得出一个可怕的结论：酷刑的程度和觉醒者的数量之间从来没有任何关联。无数的受试对象在遭受痛苦之后毫无意义地死去。

我们现在了解了其中的原理。从阿达卡利亚公约的错误中吸取教训，我们应该能够鼓励自己的人民培养出内心的小风暴，让他们充满暴风般的活力。危险的是，其中一些风暴交融个体可能会响应风暴的召唤，最终自己引发风暴。
texts.en:
Delving into the adAkkaria Convention's research, it seems that their scientists were not beholden to any recognized standard; the methodology was shoddy, the conclusions almost trite. Careful and diligent research was abandoned; depravity embraced. Yet, the more cruelty their tests subjects were subjected to, the higher the praise from Exalted Command.

Early research however, told a very different story: subjects were well treated, and respected on their journey towards awakening the "Inner Storm". In fact, comparing the success rates between early and late research, there is no escaping the horrifying conclusion: there was never any correlation between the degree of torture and and the number of awakened beings. Countless subjects suffered and died for nothing.

We now understand the principles at play. Learning from the mistakes of the adAkkaria Convention, we should be able to encourage our own people to cultivate their Inner Storms and become infused with tempestuous vigor. The danger is that some of these Storm-Fused individuals may answer the call of the storm, eventually precipitating a tempest themselves.

Delving into the adAkkaria Convention's research, it seems that their scientists were not beholden to any recognized standard; the methodology was shoddy, the conclusions almost trite. Careful and diligent research was abandoned; depravity embraced. Yet, the more cruelty their tests subjects were subjected to, the higher the praise from Exalted Command.

Early research however, told a very different story: subjects were well treated, and respected on their journey towards awakening the "Inner Storm". Countless subjects suffered and died for nothing.

Our collective now understands the principles at play. Learning from the mistakes of the adAkkaria Convention, some parts of us can cultivate their Inner Storms and become infused with tempestuous vigor. The danger is that these Storm-Fused nodes may feel the call of the storm too strongly, eventually precipitating a tempest themselves.

summary.text:
# 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密 / Secrets of the AdAkkaria Convention

- 分类 Category：项目 Project · DLC：Cosmic Storms（project_adakkaria_secrets_of）

## 如何开始 How it starts

由神器行动 artifact_adakkaria_research 启用（事件链 cs_adAkkaria_chain）：研究阿德阿卡里亚会议（庆典学院）的神器后可以启动本项目。

Enabled by the artifact action artifact_adakkaria_research (event chain cs_adAkkaria_chain): researching the adAkkaria Convention (Institute of Celebration) artifact lets you start this project.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

项目 project_adakkaria_secrets_of“阿德阿卡里亚会议的秘密”（180天，行星事件）→ cstorms.2365“潜力释放”：选项a获得修正 patriotic_institute_true_potential_unleashed，设置 patriotic_institute_supercharged 并让 adSul 首都重复生成风暴（若正处于风暴中则立刻让人口风暴融合）；选项b获得每月团结加成。

Project project_adakkaria_secrets_of "Secrets of the AdAkkaria Convention" (180 days, a planet event) → cstorms.2365 "Potential Unleashed": option a gives the modifier patriotic_institute_true_potential_unleashed, sets patriotic_institute_supercharged and makes the adSul capital spawn storms repeatedly (storm-fusing pops at once if a storm is present); option b gives a monthly unity bonus.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

选项a/b二选一；a 强化学院并反复生成风暴，b 仅得团结。

Options a/b are alternatives; a supercharges the institute and its storms, b only gives unity.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

cstorms.2365 的正文对集体意识帝国不同。

cstorms.2365's text differs for gestalt empires.
